description: Follows Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar’s mathematical explanation of the white-dwarf mass limit through quantum degeneracy pressure and special relativity, including the dispute with Eddington. Connects that work to his later studies of stellar dynamics, radiative transfer, fluid stability and black-hole perturbations.
